title: Keyboard and screen-reader friendly context-menu patterns for per-route cost breakdown
creator: Avery Chen
description: Problem: The per-route cost breakdown panel (Cost Explorer > Routes > Route > Insights) currently exposes additional actions via a right-click/context menu and hover-only icon buttons. These controls are not fully reachable or understandable by keyboard-only users and screen readers, and localized strings for the context menu actions are missing in several locales. Goal: Design and prototype a context-menu interaction pattern that is keyboard-accessible, screen-reader friendly, and i18n-ready for per-route cost breakdown and rollout controls. The solution should minimize layout shifts, respect reduced-motion preferences, and provide clear announcement semantics for assistive tech when menus open/close and when actions are executed.
acceptance_criteria: All context-menu actions must be reachable via keyboard using a discoverable focus target (e.g., a dedicated 'More' button) and through a keyboard context menu shortcut (Shift+F10 or Application key).

When opened, the context menu must trap focus and announce via ARIA: 'Menu, X items' followed by the currently focused item label; screen reader tests must validate NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver on macOS/iOS.

Hover-only icons are supplemented with visible focus styles and persistent labels on focus; color contrast for labels and focus outlines meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for UI components where applicable).

All menu labels, tooltips, and confirmation messages are present in the i18n catalog and tested for length expansion up to +40% for locales like German and Brazilian Portuguese. Layout must not overlap or clip with expanded text.
Reduced motion preference is respected: context-menu open/close uses fade (0ms if prefers-reduced-motion) and no motion-induced layout shift occurs for any locale.
Keyboard shortcuts listed in menu items are localized and exposed via a persistent help tooltip; shortcuts are customizable in future iterations (documented in the ticket).

Prototype artifacts (Figma links) include components with tokens for focus, contrast, spacing, and localization-safe truncation rules; engineering handoff includes a11y acceptance tests and example jest/playwright scripts.
design_notes:
- Introduce a single, consistent trigger for per-route actions: a 24px 'kebab' More button that is focusable and includes aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded toggled on open.
- Implement an optional keyboard-focused context invocation (Shift+F10) that anchors to the selected route row.
- Use roving tabindex pattern inside the menu and aria-activedescendant where appropriate; announce item count on open via live region fallback.
- Visual design: compact menu with 16px vertical padding, 12px horizontal padding; typography uses UI-xs token; focus ring uses token fg-accent-strong, gap to avoid overlap with localized labels.
- For locale expansion, allow menu width up to 420px; prefer wrapping labels to multiple lines over truncation for action clarity.
- Add an unobtrusive inline confirmation pattern for destructive actions (e.g., Pause Rollout) instead of modal where possible to keep flow in keyboard navigation.
- Ensure color tokens map to accessible foreground/background combos (provide token suggestions to engineering).
i18n_considerations:
- Add missing keys for: route.menu.openInsights, route.menu.pauseRollout, route.menu.viewTraffic, route.menu.copyShareLink, route.menu.openInNewTab.
- Provide context notes for translators around placeholders (e.g., 'Pause rollout for {routeName}').
- Test translations for languages with long nouns and RTL languages; ensure menu anchors flip when container is RTL.
- Use ICU message formatting for strings that contain numbers or pluralization (e.g., 'Pause rollout: {count} targets').
engineering_handoff_notes:
- Provide design tokens for focus outline, hover/focus background, spacing, and menu max-width.
- Include ARIA attributes in the component spec: role="menu", role="menuitem" for actionable items, aria-disabled for disabled items.
- Deliver a small Playwright test set to validate keyboard navigation (Tab, Shift+Tab, Arrow keys, Enter/Escape) and aXe accessibility baseline.
- Implement i18n key hooks and 40% width tests; add storybook stories for LTR and RTL.
- Track rollout in experiments to monitor any regression in action click rates via console analytics.
qa_checklist: Tab order reaches the More button before and after route name, and focus ring is visible at 3:1 contrast at minimum.
Shift+F10 opens menu anchored to last focused row; Escape closes and returns focus to trigger.
Screen reader announces menu open with item count and reads selected item when navigating with Arrow keys.
Localized strings display without overlapping controls for German and pt-BR with layout tested on 1366x768 and 320x812 viewports.
prefers-reduced-motion disables animations; menu open/close is instantaneous.
Destructive actions show inline confirmation accessible via keyboard and announced via polite live region.
